annotations.title: Trace a Solana wallet to exchanges (cash-out trail)

description: For a Solana wallet (typically a token creator), return where its SOL/USDC went: transfers followed up to 3 hops to exchange hot wallets (Binance, OKX, Coinbase, Bybit, ... from a public label set), likely exchange deposit addresses, its funding source, and its wallet group (linked creator wallets, serial-launch statistics). Covers wallets in the current forensics snapshot (creators of flagged impersonation coins, serial launchers, creators of KOL-called tokens). Patterns only, not findings about any person. Without a trial/paid key: summary preview.
name: trace_wallet
